name: Vintage Coffee & Beverages Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Vintage Coffee and Beverages Ltd manufactures and exports instant coffee and chicory[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
VCBL is a holding company of Vintage  Coffee Private Ltd and Delecto Food Pvt Ltd. It manufactures and exports Instant Coffee, Instant Chicory, and other beverages, with a foothold in private labeling. Company sells  under the brand Neocafe and Vintage

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 3.98 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -4.60%
Company has a low return on equity of 11.7% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 36.8% of their holding.
Debtor days have increased from 74.7 to 93.5 days.
